newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Arranger group completed for Hysan FRN.
newsitem.headline: Arranger group completed for Hysan FRN.

text.p: A final bank has joined the arranger group for Hysan Development Co's HK$2.0 billion five-year floating rate notes issue, coordinating arranger JP Morgan Securities Asia said on Wednesday.

Bank Austria has joined Fuji International Finance (HK), DKB Asia, Sakura Finance Asia, Sanwa International Finance, Tokyo-Mitsubishi International (HK), Societe Generale Asia, BNP and Credit Lyonnais as lead arrangers.
Each arranger will underwrite HK$200 million.
The notes were launched into syndication last week. They were issued at par to float at 56.5 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return to top tier participants is 64 basis points.
Hysan is rated A-minus by Standard and Poor's Corp.
